arxiv-1603-03194.title: Periods of Drinfeld modules and local shtukas with complex multiplication
arxiv-1603-03194.creator: Urs Hartl, Rajneesh Kumar Singh
arxiv-1603-03194.description: Abstract Colmez [ Col93 ] conjectured a product formula for periods of abelian varieties over number fields with complex multiplication and proved it in some cases. His conjecture is equivalent to a formula for the Faltings height of CM abelian varieties in terms of the logarithmic derivatives at s = 0 s=0 of certain Artin L L -functions.

arxiv-2206-10204.title: Controllability of the Schrödinger equation on unbounded domains without geometric control condition
arxiv-2206-10204.creator: Matthias Täufer
arxiv-2206-10204.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Matthias Täufer. We prove controllability of the Schrödinger equation in ℝ d \mathbb{R}^{d} in any time T > 0 T>0 with internal control supported on nonempty, periodic, open sets. This demonstrates in particular that controllability of the Schrödinger equation in full space holds for a strictly larger class of control supports than for the wave equation and suggests that the control theory of Schrödinger equation in full space might be closer to the diffusive nature of the heat equation than to the ballistic nature

arxiv-2310-20320.title: Theory of Mind in Large Language Models: Examining Performance of 11 State-of-the-Art models vs. Children Aged 7-10 on Advanced Tests

arxiv-2504-07191.title: Cornell and Coulomb potentials in the double defect spacetime
arxiv-2504-07191.creator: L. G. Barbosa, L. C. N. Santos, J. V. Zamperlini, F. M da Silva
arxiv-2504-07191.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by L. G. Barbosa, L. C. N. Santos, J. V. Zamperlini, F. M da Silva. We analyze the quantum dynamics of a scalar field in a spacetime incorporating dual topological defects, specifically a cosmic string and a global monopole. Utilizing a generalized metric that encapsulates the combined geometric effects of both defects, we solve the Klein–Gordon equation through separation of variables and examine the role of external potentials, with a focus on the generalized Cornell potential.

arxiv-2508-04275.title: The canonical form, scissors congruence and adjoint degrees of polytopes
arxiv-2508-04275.creator: T. Baumbach, A. Freyer, J. Weigert, M. Winter
arxiv-2508-04275.description: Abstract . We study the canonical form Ω \Omega as a valuation in the context of scissors congruence for polytopes. We identify the degree of its numerator – the adjoint polynomial adj P \adj_{P} – as an important invariant in this context.

pmc-11496724.title: The role of a tantalum interlayer in enhancing the properties of Fe3O4 thin films
pmc-11496724.creator: Hai Dang Ngo, Vo Doan Thanh Truong, Van Qui Le, Hoai Phuong Pham, Thi Kim Hang Pham
pmc-11496724.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). High spin polarization and low resistivity of Fe3O4 at room temperature have been an appealing topic in spintronics with various promising applications. High-quality Fe3O4 thin films are a must to achieve the goals. In this report, Fe3O4 films on different substrates (SiO2/Si(100), MgO(100), and MgO/Ta/SiO2/Si(100)) were fabricated at room temperature with radio-frequency (RF) sputtering and annealed at 450 °C for 2 h.

pmc-11573797.title: Acceptability, Feasibility, and Appropriateness of the B-OK Bottles as an Implementation Strategy for Treatment Adherence Support by Medical Case Managers
pmc-11573797.creator: Aaron Richterman, Tamar Klaiman, Rebecca Connelly, Daniel Palma, Eric Ryu, Laura Schmucker, Katherine Villarin, Gabrielle Grosso, Kathleen A Brady, Harsha Thirumurthy, Alison Buttenheim
pmc-11573797.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Antiretroviral therapy treatment adherence support by medical case managers is an evidence-based practice, but effectiveness may be constrained by limited understanding of antiretroviral therapy’s benefits among people with HIV. We used mixed methods to evaluate the pre-implementation context of the B-OK Bottles (“B-OK”) — a visual aid designed to correct HIV mental models — as an implementation strategy for treatment adherence support by medical case managers in Philadelphia.

pmc-12610002.title: Late-Onset Huntington’s Disease in Mexico: A Retrospective Study
pmc-12610002.creator: Adriana Ochoa-Morales, Kerstin Beutelspacher-Fernandez, Aurelio Jara-Prado, Petra Yescas-Gómez, Jorge Luis Guerrero-Camacho, Nelva Jacquelinne Pérez-Pacheco, David Dávila-Ortiz de Montellano, Miguel Ángel Ramírez-García
pmc-12610002.description: BackgroundHuntington’s disease (HD) is an autosomal dominant neurodegenerative disorder. It typically presents between the ages of 30 and 40 years. However, a small proportion of cases begin after the age of 60 years, which is referred to as late-onset Huntington’s disease (LoHD). This study aimed to describe the main characteristics of LoHD patients identified at Mexico’s leading neurological center.

pmc-13320559.title: Effect of rolling surface texture on bearing friction pairs lubrication
pmc-13320559.creator: Xinfu Liu, Maosheng Yin, Chunhua Liu, Jinsheng Sun, Shousen Zhang, Li Geng
pmc-13320559.description: SummaryInspired by the friction-reducing structure of pangolin scales, biomimetic conical textures were designed on bearing roller-raceway surfaces to improve tribological performance and service life. Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) based on hydrodynamic lubrication and cavitation theory was used to simulate the effects of cavitation, inflow direction, and texture parameters (depth, area ratio, and angle) on oil film load capacity.

pmc-13344034.title: Expanding visual horizons: comparative outcomes of bilateral implantation of an extended depth-of-focus versus enhanced and standard monofocal intraocular lenses
pmc-13344034.creator: Ali Altan Ertan Boz, Mahmut Atum
pmc-13344034.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposePatients undergoing cataract surgery have different postoperative visual priorities. Some primarily seek excellent uncorrected distance vision and accept the need for near spectacles, whereas others aim for greater spectacle independence across distance, intermediate, and near activities.

pmc-13635727.title: Ln-M4B3T-DOTA – a new sterically overcrowded LCT for protein pseudocontact shift NMR spectroscopy
pmc-13635727.creator: Annika Matt, Daniel Häussinger
pmc-13635727.description: Paramagnetic lanthanoid chelating tags (LCTs) enable the measurement of long-range structural restraints in biomolecular NMR spectroscopy via pseudocontact shifts and residual dipolar couplings. Herein, we report a new LCT based on the M4-cyclen scaffold bearing leucic acid side arms that yields very large anisotropic susceptibility parameters.

pmc-13681401.title: Antagonistic chromatin regulation of LHY homologs by GmASH2R and GmNF-YC4 fine-tunes soybean flowering time for latitudinal adaptation
pmc-13681401.creator: Na Zheng, Can Huang, Chengyang Song, Xiaofei Ma, Wenwen Ren, Xiulin Liu, Zhaohan Zhang, Lingyang Feng, Shangwei Zhong, Xing Wang Deng, Xiao Luo
pmc-13681401.description: Soybean (Glycine max), a photoperiod-sensitive legume critical for global protein and oil supply, relies on precise flowering-time regulation to achieve latitudinal adaptation. LATE ELONGATED HYPOCOTYL homologs (GmLHYs) promote flowering by repressing the floral inhibitor E1; however, the mechanisms that activate GmLHYs remain unclear.
